coordinate_system: Blender: right-handed, Z up. Runtime wraps the Coach in a group with rotation.x = -90deg (-> Y up). Data is NOT pre-rotated.

color_pipeline.stored: every color array in the .bin is the STORED byte (uint8). Decode ONCE on the CPU at load.
color_pipeline.phi_018: already baked into the atom/cross bytes - NOT re-applied
color_pipeline.atom_material: albedo = mix(L, L^1.6, clamp(0.8 - 0.8*srgbToLinear(Occ)))  with L = srgbToLinear(Col)   (Mat_Life_P2 node graph)
color_pipeline.envelope_material: albedo = L (Mat_Env_S01: no pow in the graph; encoded pow(c,1.6)/k=1.00 is inside the bytes). Emission = Col * 0.01
color_pipeline.shard_materials: base = emission color = L (vertex 'Col'); glass emission x2.40, rim emission x3.00, e = 1.0

atomTemplate.source: module_r3.make_module_d1 (canonical D.1 module; atoms are exact TRS of it)
